title: Log-sum-exp
hints: log_sum_exp(v) = ln(Σ exp(vᵢ)). Computed directly, it overflows for big values and gives −∞ for very negative ones.
Factor out the largest value m: ln Σ exp(vᵢ) = m + ln Σ exp(vᵢ − m). Every exponent is now ≤ 0, and the largest term is exactly 1.
m = max(v); return m + ln(Σ exp(vᵢ − m)).

tests.description: a little more than the largest value
hugely negative values (naive exp underflows to 0, and ln 0 = −∞)
a single value is its own log-sum-exp
an empty vector must be rejected
